bio_verbatim: Hi there! We're your local gardening team, here to transform your outdoor space into a place you'll love coming home to. We handle everything from lawn mowing and trimming to planting, weeding, and seasonal cleanups. Our goal is simple: a healthy, beautiful garden without the hassle for you. What we offer: Lawn Care - Mowing, edging, and fertilizing for a fresh, even look. Planting & Design - Flowers, shrubs, and greenery tailored to your space and sunlight. Maintenance - Weeding, pruning, and debris removal to keep it tidy year-round. Consultation - We assess your garden and suggest the best options for your budget. Budget Policy: If your quoted budget is $37 and we find the garden needs extra work to meet our quality standard, we'll pause and leave it as-is. We won't add costs or continue without your approval first. That way you're always in control. Ready to get started? Contact us for a free on-site estimate.
bio_source: GreenPal profile page 'bio-inner' block, fetched directly and quoted verbatim above. This is the primary source for the site's About section copy, the services list, and the free-consultation/budget-policy copy (all paraphrased, not copied verbatim, into the site's own headline/paragraph voice, but grounded in this exact real text).
